description.value: Social is a full-service restaurant and bar on Commercial Drive, one of Vancouver's most bicycle-friendly streets and a hub of the local cycling community. The venue features a street-level dining room and a rooftop patio, making it a lively spot for a sit-down meal after a ride. Reservations are accepted downstairs while the rooftop operates on a first-come, first-served basis.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: wall_loops (3 spaces) at 78m; rack at 87m. Total: 3 spaces.
